# Addanapp: code map

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Montréal software consultancy for web apps, admin panels, client portals and data platforms. AI-accelerated, human-validated, fixed quotes. Pay for results.
**Live:** https://addanapp.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/addanapp · **Layout:** classic Anvil repo with a JavaScript front end (not native Forms yet) · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/addanapp/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- This folder **is** the Anvil repo. The front end is JavaScript in `theme/assets/`, started by the client form(s) below;
  the server is `server_code/`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in `server_code`; the JavaScript reaches it through the form's bridge (see *Client side*).
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert).
- **Check**: `python -I APP_MAKER/tools/gitapp_check.py <key>`; server tests: `python -I APP_MAKER/tools/gitapp_test.py`.
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push origin master` (pull first: Anvil commits too).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py addanapp` refreshes this map.

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **leads**: name:str, email:str, company:str, kind:str, budget:str, message:str, status:str, source:str, created:dt · used in api_admin, api_client, api_public
- **notes**: request→requests, author→users, kind:str, body:str, internal:bool, status_from:str, status_to:str, progress:num, created:dt · used in api_admin, api_client, common, seed
- **requests**: ref:str, client→users, title:str, kind:str, priority:str, description:str, acceptance:str, project:str, budget:str, desired_date:date, status:str, progress:num, quote_amount:num, quote_note:str, eta:date, created:dt, updated:dt, last_activity:dt, accepted_at:dt, admin_unread:bool, client_unread:bool · used in api_admin, api_client, common, seed
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, remembered_logins:obj, signed_up:dt, email_confirmation_key:str, name:str, company:str, phone:str, color:str, role:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, email_notifications:bool, created:dt, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, lang:str · used in api_admin, common, seed

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/app-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/i18n_check.py`: Which template texts have no translation? (Offline; the UI test checks the same thing in the browse…
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
